section_summary.extract_value: This section reports correlations between BAS factors and BMI. Participants' BMI was significantly negatively correlated with General Body Appreciation (r = -.24) but not with Body Image Investment (r = .03). The negative correlation between BMI and General Body Appreciation remained significant after partialing out age, and age itself was not significantly correlated with either BAS factor.
section_summary.evidence_source: Participants' BMI was significantly negatively correlated with General Body Appreciation (r = -.24), but did not correlate with Body Image Investment (r = .03) (these correlations take into account measurement error in BAS factors). The former correlation remained significant when age was partialed out (age was not significantly correlated with either of the BAS factors).
